items.name: dsh-wsl-workspace
items.desc: Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.

items.name: dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
items.desc: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.

items.name: dsh-wsl-expose
items.desc: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.

items.name: dsh-device-bridge
items.desc: Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents (includes Termux companion example).

items.name: dsh-mac-companion
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness to macOS companion daemon (notify / Shortcuts / clipboard read-write).

items.name: dsh-remote-ssh
items.desc: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.

items.name: dsh-wsl-browser
items.desc: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.

items.name: dsh-wsl-cal
items.desc: Read-only khal calendar list.

items.name: dsh-wsl-clipboard
items.desc: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-clock
items.desc: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.

items.name: dsh-wsl-compose
items.desc: Docker Compose ps/logs with richer status; up/down double-gated.

items.name: dsh-wsl-cred
items.desc: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.

items.name: dsh-wsl-db
items.desc: Read-only psql + redis-cli probes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-defender
items.desc: Windows security posture from WSL: Defender real-time state and signature age, recent detections, exclusions, and firewall profiles.

items.name: dsh-wsl-distro
items.desc: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.

items.name: dsh-wsl-dns
items.desc: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.

items.name: dsh-wsl-docker
items.desc: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.

items.name: dsh-wsl-download
items.desc: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.

items.name: dsh-wsl-editor
items.desc: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).

items.name: dsh-wsl-encoding
items.desc: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.

items.name: dsh-wsl-env
items.desc: Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.

items.name: dsh-wsl-eventlog
items.desc: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.

items.name: dsh-wsl-expose
items.desc: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.

items.name: dsh-wsl-fetch
items.desc: Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).

items.name: dsh-wsl-git
items.desc: Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).

items.name: dsh-wsl-github
items.desc: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.

items.name: dsh-wsl-glab
items.desc: Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.

items.name: dsh-wsl-gpu
items.desc: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-helm
items.desc: Read-only Helm list / status / history.

items.name: dsh-wsl-hostsvc
items.desc: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.

items.name: dsh-wsl-im
items.desc: Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty allowedUserIds means EVERYONE can drive your agent — set a whitelist before exposing a bot.

items.name: dsh-wsl-jev
items.desc: Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).

items.name: dsh-wsl-k8s
items.desc: Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).

items.name: dsh-wsl-launch
items.desc: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-llamacpp
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).

items.name: dsh-wsl-mail
items.desc: Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).

items.name: dsh-wsl-media
items.desc: Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).

items.name: dsh-wsl-mnt
items.desc: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.

items.name: dsh-wsl-net
items.desc: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-notify
items.desc: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-obscura
items.desc: Optional Obscura headless-browser tools from WSL (obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint). Not the same as dsh-wsl-browser win_open_url (Windows GUI browser), and not a replacement for dsh-wsl-fetch web_fetch.

items.name: dsh-wsl-obsidian
items.desc: Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: status/list/search/read/write/append, wikilink resolve, write/append require confirm=true, plus obsidian:// open. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.

items.name: dsh-wsl-ollama
items.desc: Local Ollama status / list / chat / embed for dsh on WSL (unreachable status includes Windows/WSL gateway hints).

items.name: dsh-wsl-open
items.desc: Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.

items.name: dsh-wsl-path
items.desc: Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-perf
items.desc: Windows host performance from WSL: CPU, memory, disk and top processes.

items.name: dsh-wsl-picker
items.desc: Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).

items.name: dsh-wsl-pkg
items.desc: Dependency tree summaries: npm / pip / cargo.

items.name: dsh-wsl-playwright
items.desc: Headless Playwright fetch (title + body text) in WSL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-port
items.desc: Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.

items.name: dsh-wsl-power
items.desc: Windows power state from WSL: active power plan, all schemes, battery, sleep timeout and hibernation availability.

items.name: dsh-wsl-rclone
items.desc: Read-only rclone listremotes / lsf / about.

items.name: dsh-wsl-registry
items.desc: Read-only Windows registry access from WSL, restricted to an allowlist of key prefixes; list a key's values or its child keys.

items.name: dsh-wsl-search
items.desc: Sandboxed ripgrep / fd / ast-grep under allowRoots (defaults include ~/.dsh/im-workspace).

items.name: dsh-wsl-secret
items.desc: Read-only pass / age secrets with allowPrefixes; reveal defaults to false.

items.name: dsh-wsl-service
items.desc: Read Windows service state from WSL: list services, or inspect one by name with its dependencies, logon account and binary path.

items.name: dsh-wsl-shot
items.desc: Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).

items.name: dsh-wsl-ssh-agent
items.desc: Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.

items.name: dsh-wsl-struct
items.desc: Sandboxed jq / yq / read-only sqlite3.

items.name: dsh-wsl-systemd
items.desc: Read-only systemd --user list / show / journal.

items.name: dsh-wsl-terraform
items.desc: Terraform/OpenTofu plan summary + state list (never apply).

items.name: dsh-wsl-tmux
items.desc: Read-only tmux list + capture-pane.

items.name: dsh-wsl-tray
items.desc: Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.

items.name: dsh-wsl-uia
items.desc: Windows UI Automation from WSL: enumerate top-level windows, read a bounded element tree, and wait for or trace the path to a named element.

items.name: dsh-wsl-vecmem
items.desc: Tiny local vector memory via Ollama embeddings and ~/.dsh/vecmem (workspace namespaces; optional IM crumb via vecmemOnReply).

items.name: dsh-wsl-vllm
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible vLLM client (default :8000).

items.name: dsh-wsl-winctl
items.desc: Enumerate and control Windows top-level windows from WSL: activate, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize, set always-on-top, close.

items.name: dsh-wsl-wininput
items.desc: Targeted Windows input from WSL: invoke a UI Automation element by name, or send keys, clicks and mouse wheel to a chosen window.

items.name: dsh-wsl-winshot
items.desc: Capture a Windows window to a WSL file, whole or cropped to a region or to a named UI element.

items.name: dsh-wsl-workspace
items.desc: Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.

items.name: dsh-wsl-wslconfig
items.desc: Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.

items.name: dsh-win-toolkit
items.desc: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.

items.name: dsh-wsl-native
items.desc: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.

items.name: dsh-wsl-gpufix
items.desc: Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.

items.name: dsh-open-folder-visible
items.desc: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action: the shipped opener spawns explorer.exe with windowsHide, so the File Explorer window is created invisible and the click reports success without appearing.

items.name: dsh-wsl-tray
items.desc: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.

items.name: dsh-windows-native
items.desc: Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.

items.name: dsh-wsl-bridge
items.desc: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.

items.name: dsh-wsl
items.desc: Linux-native DSH, extended to WSL. Commands run on a real kernel: exit codes, signals, timeouts. One long-lived shell for multi-step work, a clean one for everything else; subtasks stay visible above the composer. Your own terminal stays in the loop — commands in view, keyboard one click away. Path conversion, environment checks, background jobs; destructive commands ask first. Runs as you, below the DSH sandbox (it does not confine it); the in-view terminal exists up to DSH 0.2.0.

items.name: dsh-wsl-first
items.desc: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
